method: Live browser accessibility tree after reload, plus screenshot of the header, table and start of methods. All table cells were reconciled through the rendered accessibility tree; the wide table scrolls horizontally.

row.locator: Exhibit 2.5, printed p. 25 (PDF p. 54); Exhibit D.1, printed p. D-2 (PDF p. 192)

checks: Concise dataset description appears above the table
Source numeric values, negative lower bound and formatted confidence level render in named columns
Methods render in a separate labeled Markdown block
Revised reader-facing methods remove repeated instructions and storage mechanics
Methods retain mixed study design, time periods, counterfactual distinction, uncertainty and limitations
Primary PDF link, study link, country link and entry link are present
Publication coverage explicitly identifies this as a one-row pilot
limitations: Geo adds a 0% Claim rating in the Name cell; it is not the study effect or confidence level
The wide table requires horizontal scrolling
Only the pilot is published; this is not full Reading First or dashboard acceptance
